messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

This swelling is known as peripheral edema.
The swelling may add to weight changes.
The swelling becomes more common with age.

The relation 'contributes to' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or effect may contribute to or exacerbate the object condition or effect.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

A. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
B. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'reduces': The subject drug decreases or lessens the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
E. 'improves': The subject drug enhances or positively affects the condition or parameter specified by the object entity.
